headline: Video learning you can measure
alt: Modern Video Player hero cover — the player, engagement heatmap and player-style skins in a 3D window cluster, with Moodle 4.5–5.2 / GPLv3 chips.

headline: Playback you can prove
alt: Server-validated playback: watch-time and max-verified position computed on the server, forward-seek guard, and heartbeat tracking with suspicious-seek integrity flags.

headline: Completion that can't be gamed
alt: Completion conditions in the activity form — complete by watched percentage or validated end-of-video, required watch percentage (default 95) enforced server-side, gradebook with grade-to-pass.

headline: See exactly where attention drops
alt: Engagement analytics — the audience-retention heatmap built from validated segments, the learner-progress KPI strip and audit-ready exports.

headline: Content protection, built in
alt: Content protection — dynamic name/email watermark, screen-capture deterrence with a tamper-evident log, and signed user-bound video URLs that expire.

headline: Seven player styles, one engine
alt: Player-style selector listing seven skins — YouTube, Vimeo, Netflix, Plyr, Apple, Classic and Minimal — with identical tracking and enforcement across every style.

headline: Any source, delivered securely
alt: Video source picker — upload, external URL, YouTube/Vimeo, or S3-compatible and Azure Blob cloud storage with short-lived signed delivery from your own bucket.

headline: Get Modern Video Player
alt: Closing call to action — Modern Video Player for Moodle 4.5–5.2, GPLv3, stable, with a 30-day money-back guarantee; upgrade the free Community edition in place.
